data.narrative:
Runpod is a Series C-stage company in Chips & Semiconductors that has raised $122.3M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 8 private and 3 public comparables in the semiconductor and chip design space, including Tenstorrent ($2.7B), Nearfield Instruments ($1.6B), Positron AI ($1.0B), and DEEPX ($529M).

Two valuation methods proved applicable. Stage-progression analysis, using total capital raised as a proxy base and applying a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical for Series C advancement, implies a valuation of $208M. Peer-median analysis across the four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables yields a median valuation of $1.3B, with a range spanning $529M to $2.7B. Public-comp anchoring using semiconductor sector price-to-sales multiples (median 18.9x across ALAB, NVDA, and AMD) cannot be applied due to unavailable revenue data for Runpod.

Triangulating these two methods produces an indicative range of $177M to $1.5B, with a median of $754M. The wide spread reflects genuine uncertainty inherent in early-stage valuation: stage-progression relies on capital raised as a proxy absent disclosed metrics, while peer medians span an outsized range driven by heterogeneous company trajectories and funding environments. Key uncertainties include Runpod's unit economics, revenue run rate, and product-market traction relative to the peer set.
